stage: Frozen before fitting any weights or inspecting validation/holdout quality
refinement: Fit only quiescent-stable rows: baseline v0.17 full-window quiescence and static score must differ by at most 50 cp. The selected features describe quiet positional value; unresolved tactical swings are handled by the unchanged search. All excluded roots/replies and labels remain raw evidence.
existing_filters: CP-only, nonchecked, no claimable draw, halfmove<=60, abs(base)<=1500 and abs(teacher)<=1500; deduplicate first-four-FEN-field board identity globally, retaining exclusions and grouping all related rows by opening family.
target: teacher White cp minus baseline static White cp, clipped to +/-400 cp; no intercept
selection: Bounded nonnegative ridge in RMS-standardized feature coordinates; integer-round weights and select by validation MAE after clipping both teacher and prediction to +/-1000 cp. Write selected weights before unlocking holdout metrics.
gate: Holdout clipped CP MAE improves >=5% and raw absolute errors >300 cp do not increase more than 10%; candidate must beat baseline, not merely choose a teacher PV. Runtime and independent geometry gates also required. No retuning to holdout.
